newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain higher.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash prices remained mostly up in line with higher MGE futures on Wednesday, dealers said.
Dealers in North Dakota and Montana cited some farmer selling and said the gain in wheat futures could prompt farmers to sell even more of their crop.
"Farmers are kind of waiting. I suspect I will have a couple of farmers letting go of a little bit" of wheat, a Montana dealer said.
"People see this runup in wheat and are giving up a little in the nearby, mostly spring (wheat)," another dealer said.
March MGE spring wheat futures gained 9-1/2 cents to end at $3.88 a bushel.
Another supportive factor was the Commodity Credit Corp's purchase of 40,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat, February 20-March 15 delivery, for export to Pakistan, one Oregon dealer said.
